title: Sectionwise cocycle primitives for increasing-tuple intersection presheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$, $G$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. For $p\in\mathbb N$ and $V\subseteq U_i$, every section $z$ of degree $p+1$ of the explicit intersection-product presheaf complex [def-pc-s3-alternating-cech-sheaf-construction] satisfying $d^{p+1}z=0$ is $d^p y$ for a section $y$ of degree $p$. This statement concerns sections of the explicit presheaf terms before sheafification or integer extension.

source.place: Tag 02FU (cohomology-lemma-covering-resolution), with the increasing-tuple convention of Tag 01FM

proof.text: Use the existing positive signed insertion identity to obtain s and t. Evaluate the identity at V and z. Since z is a cocycle, its d followed by t term is zero. The remaining identity is restriction of z to V intersect U i equals d of s(z). Restrict s(z) back along V ≤ V intersect U i, which exists from hV. Naturality of d identifies its image with the reverse restriction of the previous identity. The two restriction arrows compose to the identity because the category of opens is thin. Functoriality gives d y = z. This argument also covers empty opens and empty tuple products.

lean.statement:
theorem alternatingCechSheafPresheaf_local_cocycles
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (G : X.Modules) (i : Fin r)
    (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U i)
    (z : (alternatingCechSheafPresheafTerms U G (p + 1)).obj (op V))
    (hz : (alternatingCechSheafPresheafD U G (p + 1)).app (op V) z = 0) :
    ∃ y : (alternatingCechSheafPresheafTerms U G p).obj (op V),
      (alternatingCechSheafPresheafD U G p).app (op V) y = z
